title: SPINDEP: Spin-Dependent Exotic Interaction Analysis Framework
description: A Python framework for comparing matter and antimatter coupling-constant bounds on spin-dependent exotic interactions, classified by the Dobrescu–Mocioiu potentials (V1–V16), and testing their consistency with CPT symmetry. It discovers and matches matter/antimatter constraint datasets across lepton-lepton, lepton-nucleon and nucleon-nucleon sectors, interpolates them onto a common interaction-range grid, computes the asymmetry parameter A = (g_matter − g_antimatter)/(g_matter + g_antimatter), and runs chi-squared significance tests. Developed for an M.Sc. thesis in Physics at the University of Ibadan.
